flank_hit_rule: one near-exact end-to-end hit for each flank; correct orientation from source manifest; left hit must precede right hit
read_span_summary: median of bp strictly between the two natural-flank hits
binary_rule: abs(assembly_span_bp - median_read_span_bp) > max(2, ceil(0.05 * max(assembly_span_bp, median_read_span_bp)))
truth: exact injected assembly bp deletion; intact case is negative; physical donor copy truth unavailable
purpose: technical stop-loss diagnostic for a source-guided development lineage; no biological sensitivity claim
read_pairing: same published sample 9994; exact DNA extraction not separately established
